description: This file contains functions for generating HSN-wise summary reports of outward supplies, including data retrieval, tax calculations, JSON export, and report column definitions within an ERPNext customization.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main entry point to generate the report, calls _execute with filters.

methods.name: _execute
methods.description: Performs data retrieval, tax calculation, and data merging for the report based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the HSN-wise summary report.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_items
methods.description: Fetches sales invoice items matching the filters from the database.

methods.name: get_tax_accounts
methods.description: Calculates item-wise tax amounts and prepares tax columns.

methods.name: get_merged_data
methods.description: Merges rows with the same HSN code by summing numeric fields.

methods.name: get_json
methods.description: Generates a JSON representation of the report data for GST filing.

methods.name: download_json_file
methods.description: Prepares the report JSON data for download as a file.

methods.name: get_hsn_wise_json_data
methods.description: Formats report data into JSON structure for GST reporting, including tax calculations.
